Price_Performance_Observation: The ~15k premium for HD560S is small versus ATH-R30x and the latter's H7 improvement is only small/uncertain; prioritize 560S while promo is available.
HD560S cheaper by ~47k under promo and HD505 has no verified technical/perceptual gain; prefer 560S on value evidence.
HD560S lower listed price; R50x lighter, brighter and good measured channel matching; not proven worse.
Extra 65k for HD550 may earn newer fuller tuning but same broad tonal-upgrade tier; compare fit/music, don't assert resolution gain.
HD600 historical vocal reference remains special; 315k promo sold out; current actual 333k seller price not fully verified.
SRH440A marginally cheaper but strong H7 improvement not established; HD560S better documented midrange sound.
FT1 warm/bass focus versus K371 neutral/voice reference; low comparable prices, sound-profile trade-off.
FT1 cheaper and strongly musical bass; MDR-M1 adds professional Sony monitor and service options, but shallow pad and recessed presence risk.
K361 cheaper ~26k, FT1 warmer fuller cinematic bass and changed build/parts; no decisive all-use acoustic advantage.
Kithara adds cost ~164k, heavier 420g and likely gains have not been proven versus FT1 PRO; however pads/mic/tuning differ and sound reviewers diverge.
FT5 substantially dearer and heavier, review reports darker tone; listener preference/fit may justify but clearer measurable sound edge unproven.
MM100 about double cost, reviewer listening opinions conflict, 475g; currently weak verified increment compared to FT1 PRO.
Hadenys costs ~3× Oct HD550 promo; more premium build and signature but detail gain over HD550 not calibrated.
Azurys ~3× FT1 nominal indexed quote but distinct premium materials and tonal sophistication; no quantified gain.
DT900 PRO X higher price with robust pad/headband and tuning benefits, but technical gains relative to HD560S not proven.
H6 Air about half MDR-MV1 price; MV1 studio build, extended bass and different presentation, neither dominates.
VIRTUOSO PRO actually passive analog open, yet headset/mic has little benefit in this use case; detailed fidelity advantage vs HD560S not proven.
SR7000 closed has isolation and special vocal character, but price >2.7× FT1 PRO and no evidence of proportionate gains; not strictly comparable.
Sony H6 Air extremely light and intended for games; music improvement over HD560S for additional ~57k unproven.
Meze 105 AER costs more and has musical relaxed presentation, comfort/serviceability; not all-measurement dominance.
